neighbours.label: A list of pieces in z + r words: ' razor', 'R' in RAZR, 'azer' in Razer, 'or' in Mahzor and Mazor, 'ir' in Nazir; other words in the same slots stay quiet, and other z words (lizard, wizard, hazard) do too.
fire: Her barber still uses an old straight razor at work.
The folding RAZR phone came back this spring.
A Razer keyboard glowed on the desk.
Cantor Levy opened his Mahzor at the page.
The Mazor family lit candles on Friday.
A Nazir abstains from wine for a set period.
Sharpen the razor on a leather strap.
Old Mahzor pages lay in the attic.
quiet: Her barber still uses old electric clippers at work.
The folding Nokia phone came back this spring.
A wireless keyboard glowed on the desk.
Cantor Levy opened his hymnal at the page.
The Cohen family lit candles on Friday.
A lizard hides from the sun for a set period.
Sharpen the wizard's blade on a leather strap.
Old prayer pages lay in the attic.

short: z + r words: razor, RAZR, Razer, Mahzor, Nazir
notes: Probes: 0.29-1.03. I tried the pattern on new words, and it does not generalize: lizard, wizard, Mozart, bizarre, czar, hazard 0.00-0.04; Nazareth 0.29, Zohar 0.18, Mazor 0.95. So this stays a list rather than a spelling rule.
